title: How to sleep better
instructions: Bir sağlık podcast'inde uyku hakkında öneriler. Uzun bir metin; sayılara ve "yap / yapma" önerilerine dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Hello and welcome to Healthy Life. Today we're talking about sleep.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Most adults need seven to nine hours of sleep every night, but many people only sleep five or six.

script.speaker: host
script.text: So, how can you sleep better? Here are some ideas.

script.speaker: host
script.text: First, go to bed and get up at the same time every day, even at the weekend.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Second, don't drink coffee or tea after four o'clock in the afternoon.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Third, stop using your phone one hour before bed. The light from the screen keeps your brain awake.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Some people read a book instead. That is a much better idea.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Exercise is good for sleep too, but don't do sport late in the evening.

script.speaker: host
script.text: And finally, keep your bedroom cool and dark. Eighteen degrees is perfect.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Next week, we will talk about healthy breakfasts. Sleep well!
